Edit your arrival time

Correct a missed or mistaken arrival.

Use the Mac four-digit HH:mm editor or Windows manual entry, with clear rules for valid times.

Mac 1.5.17 build33 · Windows 1.5.13
OverviewHow to useExampleScope and limitsRelated features

Correct today’s arrival

Enter an arrival manually if you started the app late or its first observation differs from your arrival. Manual entry does not apply the automatic 08:00 normalization.

Mac 1.5.17 edits four HH:mm digits inside the panel. Windows 1.5.13 uses the Manual entry action in Today and a separate manual-entry window.

Enter a time on each platform

  1. On Mac, open HappyLulu from the menu bar and click the arrival digits.
  2. Type four digits or use the + above and − below each digit. Digits do not carry or wrap.
  3. Press Enter, click elsewhere or close the panel to save. Escape cancels.
  4. On Windows, left-click the tray icon, choose Manual entry, select today’s time and workday mode, then save.

Mac also offers manual arrival in Settings → Work. Editing only the time preserves the current manual mode or automatic calendar recognition. With no arrival, the Mac editor proposes the current time; closing without changing digits still saves it if valid.

Change 09:10 to 09:00

At 09:20, a regular-day arrival of 09:10 can be corrected to 09:00. With eight work hours, one break hour and no reduction, expected departure changes from 18:10 to 18:00.

Entering 09:30 at 09:20 fails because it is in the future. Manually entering 06:30 does not normalize to 08:00; it fails the allowed-window check.

What can be saved

Regular and afternoon-off arrivals allow 08:00–10:00; morning off allows 13:00–15:00, including the final minute. The time must be valid and today. Future times, stale-date edits, invalid HH:mm and times incompatible with the selected mode are rejected.

Invalid Mac input keeps the original record and displays an error. Saving a manual arrival can resume a day paused by Day off or leave, so check the mode and expected departure after saving.

Windows 1.5.13 does not include Mac’s per-digit +/− controls or panel autosave. This feature corrects today’s arrival; it does not fill historical records.
